# Aunt Euphemia

## Overview

- **Age:** Elderly  <sub>[v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Phemie  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013)</sub>; Aunty J.  <sub>[v3 c24 P5](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a small and elderly woman with a tiny, gently triangular face, soft blue eyes, and rosy cheeks. She has silver-white hair arranged in small rolls above her ears.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014)_

## Personality

Aunt Euphemia is cheerful, indulgent, and tolerant, possessing an irrepressible youthfulness and a lively sense of humor. Although outmoded in her personal views, she believes in letting young people enjoy their lives without overly strict supervision. She has a deep fondness for cats and is immensely loved by those around her.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014), [v1 c26 P16](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0016)_

## Traits

- Cheerful  <sub>[v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014)</sub>
- Indulgent
- Lively sense of humor  <sub>[v1 c26 P16](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0016)</sub>
- Fond of cats
- Afraid of snakes  <sub>[v1 c31 P3](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0003), [v3 c34 P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025)</sub>

## Abilities

- Fine needlework and knitting  <sub>[v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v3 c35 P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)</sub>
- Housekeeping and culinary skills  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v3 c35 P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- Provide a comfortable home for Mabel, Nell, Honora, and Cressida at Tabby's Place  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014)</sub>

## History

Aunt Euphemia agreed to move to Portmaris and act as housekeeper for her niece Mabel Colby and her friends Nell, Honora, and Cressida at Tabby's Place. She established a cozy, welcoming atmosphere in the home, bringing along two cats, Joseph and the Sarah-cat, and eventually adopting a third named Smudge. During their time together, she provided gentle guidance, excellent meals, and indulgent companionship to the girls throughout their university studies. She remained at Tabby's Place over the summer break to care for the cats, and later hosted the girls again during their senior year. After the girls graduated, she decided to travel to India to visit her daughter in the mission field.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014), [v1 c35 P0](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0000), [v1 c36 P0](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0000), [v1 c37 P0](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0000), [v1 c37 P17](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0017), [v3 c34 P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), [v3 c35 P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Her real name is Jamesina, named after her father James who drowned at sea before her birth  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013)</sub>
- She was previously married, and her husband died prior to her moving to Portmaris  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039)</sub>
- Her only daughter married and left for the foreign mission field in India  <sub>[v1 c26 P13](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0013), [v1 c26 P23](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0023), [v3 c34 P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025)</sub>
- Her daughter earned a Master of Arts degree before becoming a missionary  <sub>[v1 c30 P16](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0016)</sub>

## Quotes

> If you will ever understand how to conduct yourselves, you are at an age to know it now. Therefore, as it pertains to me, you are all free to ruin yourselves as you see fit.  <sub>[v1 c26 P14](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0014)</sub>

> A person can easily catch rheumatism in her legs, Nell. However, solely the elderly ought to experience soul rheumatism. Fortunately, I have escaped it entirely.  <sub>[v3 c25 P9](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0009)</sub>

> Don't worry. Thank goodness we still don't have to pay for air and salvation.  <sub>[v3 c26 P4](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0004)</sub>

> Fulfill what you owe to God, to those around you, and to yourself, while enjoying your life. Such is the doctrine I live by, and it has served me quite effectively.  <sub>[v3 c30 P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003)</sub>

> The four of you have been the sweetest, dearest, best girls who ever attended college as a group.  <sub>[v3 c37 P13](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0013)</sub>
